spans.s:
(ऋ) षेकृ r. 1st cl. (सेकते)
To go, to move; preferably सेक.

(ऋ) सेकृ r. 1st cl. सेकते
To go, to move.

m. (-कः)
1 Sprinkling, aspersion, as of a fluid, or of Ghee on the sacrificial fire, &c.
2 Seminal effusion.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.

n. (-चं)
A bucket, a baling vessel.
E.
सेक sprinkling, and पाच vessel.

n. (-मं)
A radish.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, इमच् aff.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
Sprinkling, aspergent, who or what sprinkles.
m. (-क्ता)
A husband.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, aff. तृच्.

n. (-क्त्रं)
A bucket.
E.
षिच् to sprinkle, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
